description.zh: 让 Agent 能搜索网页、驱动真实浏览器，并让纯文本模型看懂截图。这一组会给模型增加较多工具定义，建议按需安装。
description.en: Lets the agent search the web, drive a real browser, and read screenshots with a text-only model. Adds many tool definitions to the model's context, so install it when you need it.

why.zh: 联网搜索网页与 X，返回结构化结果
why.en: Web and X search with structured results

why.zh: 用结构化工具驱动真实 Chrome
why.en: Drive real Chrome with structured tools

why.zh: 给纯文本模型补上看图能力（OCR、版面）
why.en: Gives text-only models vision: OCR and layout
